evidence_class: post-hoc offline construction and exact-bound probe; not independent trials
finite_control: Prototype remains an explicit rational_count control; it has better checked finite bounds at several large lengths although its limiting error is slightly higher.
limits: Scalar two/eight-word family only; smaller lengths lose to C69 and the rational control wins at some larger lengths. Generic quantization, entropy coding, time sharing and arithmetic intervals are established. No optimal finite code, near-C67 guarantee, natural benefit or publication-priority conclusion.
prototype: Actual codec/finite source bytes copied before revising the public count; rational 2/3 count with ceil(2*sqrt(k)) fewer oracle blocks.
revision: Entropy count uses an exact integer entropy inequality and ceil(sqrt(k*ceil(log2(k+1)))) slack. Scratch probe imports evolving production code; current exact checker regenerates values. No fully frozen historical runtime is asserted.
